structured_output.what_is_happening: Pinto is a pump.fun coin that finished its bonding curve and moved to PumpSwap only 25 seconds after it was created (created 1790389981, migrated 1790390006). That points to a bundled or coordinated launch. About 14 minutes after migration it is at roughly $115k market cap, up about 120% from the pool's opening price and just under its $130k all-time high. The first 15 minutes drew about 2,270 unique buyers and about 2,100 unique sellers, with about $110k of volume. The latest 5 minutes are much quieter on GeckoTerminal: $13k of volume and 63 buyers, against about 2,244 buyers in the 15-minute window. Price is flat over the last 5 minutes. The project has no website, no socials and no DexScreener profile, and no paid boosts.

Activity is fading quickly after the first 15 minutes

structured_output.thesis: This looks like a bundled, instantly bonded pump.fun launch with no narrative, 14 minutes old and near its high, with the first-15-minute burst now cooling. The structure is clean (LP burned, holdings well spread, dev holds little), so a liquidity pull is unlikely. The more likely failure is a slow bleed as the bundle and early buyers sell into a fading bid. Doubling from about $115k needs a fresh wave of attention that the packet gives no sign of.
